In this role, you will be instrumental in ensuring the quality and reliability of our complex web and mobile travel applications. You will work closely with product management, development, and operations teams to understand project requirements, define test strategies, and execute comprehensive testing plans. Your expertise will be crucial in maintaining the high standards of our software products, contributing to our mission of delivering exceptional travel solutions. What You Will Be Doing: Helping to test complex web travel applications. Designing and executing test cases to verify software functionality and usability. Conducting various types of testing, including functional testing (UI/API), regression testing, and integration testing. (both manual and automated) Performing ad-hoc and exploratory testing for areas that require immediate attention or have high-risk user scenarios that are not covered by automated tests. Identifying, reporting, and tracking defects using appropriate tools and methodologies. Writing and maintaining comprehensive test documentation, including test plans, test cases, bug reports, and sporadic internal knowledge base articles (e.g., Confluence). Taking a direct part in the discussion and planning of new features with TPM and Team Lead, alongside the creation of corresponding test plans. Collaborating with PM and Team Lead to understand project requirements and objectives. Striving for the highest possible test coverage with automated tests, including overseeing the sufficiency and coverage at all levels. Collaborating with developers to ensure that unit and component tests are well-integrated. Writing and maintaining automated tests at the integration and end-to-end levels. You Certainly: Have a passion for quality and great attention to detail. Possess 5+ years of experience in web application testing, including UI/API, functional/non-functional testing, and are familiar with the practices of regular product delivery and its testing in this context. Have hands-on experience with exploratory testing. Have hands-on experience with API testing tools such as Postman, Swagger, and Curl. Have experience with creating and maintaining test documentation beyond just bug reports and test cases. Are able to write clear, easy-to-follow bug reports, checklists, and feature requests. Are familiar with basic programming principles and have a conceptual knowledge of modern software engineering processes, including version control systems, issue tracking, and continuous integration. Have experience running automation tests and analyzing reports. Have excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken. Are self-motivated, proactive, and able to multitask, prioritize your work, and deliver on time, with a desire for continuous improvement. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer Lead/Senior
jobs.description: Our clients work in industries where quality and speed go hand-in-hand — and we're looking for smart, pragmatic Lead QA engineer who know how to test fast, test deep, and raise the right questions at the right time. You'll work closely with Business Analysts, Developers, and Product Owners to deliver features that are not only functional, but sustainable. These roles vary by project — some focus on Salesforce-based platforms , others on SaaS implementations and integrations or process automation and AI . You might work on a greenfield implementation, or join a fast-moving delivery phase to bring order, insight, and stability into complex ecosystems. Requirements What you'll do Develop and implement comprehensive test strategies and plans for complex features and systems. Analyze requirements and user stories to define test cases and identify risks. Design and execute functional, regression, exploratory, performance and load tests. Validate business logic, integrations , and cross-system behavior. Collaborate with developers, analysts, and architects to build quality in from the start. Mentor junior QA engineers, promoting best practices and fostering a culture of quality. Support UAT and end-to-end cycles and document findings clearly. Test automations, flows, APIs and UI , depending on project nature. Integrate testing activities into the CI/CD pipeline, ensuring continuous quality assurance. We're looking for people who have... Experience as a QA in cloud-based projects (ideally SaaS). Fluent English and good communication skills (written and verbal). A solid understanding of how business logic translates into systems. Strong curiosity and a mindset for problem solving. Proficiency with test management tools and issue tracking systems (e.g. Jira). Strong hands-on experience with API testing, including understanding of REST principles, authentication mechanisms (e.g., OAuth 2.0), and tools like Postman, SoapUI, or similar. Familiarity with SQL and database concepts for data validation. Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining automated test scripts and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Postman collections for API). Nice to have ISTQB or similar certifications Knowledge of Salesforce ecosystem (Sales, Service, Experience Cloud) Exposure to AppExchange packages (e.g., Formstack, Calendly, S-Drive) Highlights Shape the future of digital transformation projects with your analytical expertise. 100% remote with flexible hours and international clients.
